tourPresets.title: Tour presets
tourPresets.subtitle: Ready-made shortcuts for starting the new-tour wizard faster
tourPresets.intro: A preset is a starting template for tour creation. Define one for each tour type your team runs often (for example “3-day trek” or “family nature walk”) so operators do not start from a blank form every time.
tourPresets.introBulletWizard: “Start with this preset” opens the new-tour wizard and pre-fills the tour title and default theme (when set) from this preset.
tourPresets.introBulletDescription: The description field is for your team only — it is not shown on the public tour form.
tourPresets.introBulletAdvanced: To auto-select a preset when creating tours, see
tourPresets.addDescription: Pick a short name and optionally a default theme.
tourPresets.nameHint: Shown in the preset list and suggested as the tour title when the title field is still empty.
tourPresets.descriptionHint: Internal note for your team — e.g. “half-day tours around the city” or “spring season only”.
tourPresets.themeHint: From tour themes in settings. Applied when the wizard has no theme selected yet.
tourPresets.empty: No presets yet. Create one for your most common tour type so the team can start new tours faster.
